title: Turn on my microphone
description: Be heard in your next meeting. Understand mute and permissions.
tags: zoom meet teams audio sound unmute mic microphone awaz meeting call
goal: Let the other person hear you.
why: An app needs microphone permission, and the microphone must also be unmuted. These are two different controls.
steps: Verify that your voice is on
hint: A crossed-out microphone means mute. If permission is blocked, changing mute alone cannot fix it.

title: Share only one window
description: Show your presentation without sharing everything on your screen.
tags: zoom meet teams screen share presentation window tab conference
goal: Share the presentation window, then stop sharing.
why: Sharing one window limits what is visible. Sharing your entire screen can expose other windows and notifications.
hint: Choose Window, select the presentation, then share it. Check the preview before stopping.

title: Blur my background
description: Keep the focus on you, with a little more privacy behind you.
tags: zoom meet teams blur background effects camera video conference
goal: Apply background blur and check your preview.
why: Blur softens the space behind you. It does not hide your face, all objects, or anything you share on screen.
hint: Open Effects and choose Blur. The room should become softer while the person stays clear.

title: Send a document as a PDF
ur: Document ko PDF bana kar bhejein
description: Export a file, find it, and attach a copy to a message.
tags: pdf download export save canva document presentation attach send file email
goal: Export the sample document as PDF, then attach and send it.
why: Exporting creates a copy in a chosen format. A downloaded PDF is a file you can attach; it is different from a link to an online document.
hint: Choose PDF in Export. Open Downloads, select the sample PDF, attach it, and send the practice message.

title: Share with the right person
ur: Sahi shakhs ke saath share karein
description: See who can open your link before you send it.
tags: share link access private photo group family audience permission sana google drive
goal: Give Sana, and only Sana, access to the sample file.
why: A restricted link gives access only to the people you choose in this simulation. Removing access cannot erase a copy someone already downloaded.
hint: Select Only Sana. Check the recipient view, then confirm who has access.

title: Fix a form that will not submit
description: Find the missing detail without starting all over again.
tags: form submit error email government portal registration upload missing city
goal: Correct the sample email and choose a city, then submit.
why: A validation message tells you which detail needs attention. Pressing Submit is not the same as seeing a confirmation.
hint: The sample email needs text after the dot, such as sana@example.com. Choose a city too. Use fictional details only.

title: Join a video meeting
description: Check your name and controls before you enter the call.
tags: join zoom meet meeting call conference video link enter
goal: Join the practice meeting with your camera off and microphone muted.
why: The preview lets you choose what others will hear and see before joining. You can change those controls later.
hint: Turn off both Camera and Microphone, then choose Join. The preview shows your current choices.

title: Understand a file versus a link
ur: File aur link ka farq samjhein
description: Know whether you are sending a copy or giving access.
tags: file link copy download attach share drive canva permission access
goal: Choose a downloaded copy, then identify what happens when online access is removed.
why: An attachment is a separate copy. A link points to an online item. Removing access to the online item does not delete a copy already saved.
steps: Choose a copy instead of a link
hint: Choose the PDF attachment. A saved copy stays with its recipient even if online access is removed.
